question: Which goddess appears in ka and takes the form of the womb in e?
premises: The goddess Sundarī is present in the syllable ka.
The syllable e is another locus of identification.
In the syllable e she has the form of the womb.
inference: The goddess Sundarī is associated with ka and manifests in womb-form in the syllable e.
plain_english: In the syllable ka is the goddess Sundarī, and in the syllable e she has the form of the womb.
